svg.aria-label: Animated diagram: a source dropped in inbox is read by Claude Code, its key claims are verified against primary sources, the source and the evidence are archived immutably in raw, summary and wiki pages are written with citations to the archive, index and log are updated, questions are answered with inline citations and durable answers are filed as syntheses
svg.title: How the second brain works
svg.text: Sources are verified and archived once, compiled into linked pages, then queried with citations

g.text: Drop one source in inbox/ and say "process this"
Claude checks the claims that matter against primary sources
The source and every page it was checked against are archived in raw/
A source summary, then every concept, entity, decision and lesson it touches
Claims cite the archived copy, never a bare URL, so link rot can't erase evidence
index.md and log.md record what exists and what happened
Ask anything: Claude reads the index and answers with inline citations
Answers with lasting value are filed under wiki/syntheses/
Say "lint": contradictions, stale checks, orphan pages and uncited claims surface
